The question asks about "everything on the plate", which is the toast and two eggs. I'm treating the plate as just those two items.

- Two poached or steamed eggs at about 50 g each come to about 100 g and roughly 150 kcal.
- One slice of wholegrain toast is about 40 g and roughly 100 kcal.

That gives about 140 g and 250 kcal in total.

{"kcal": 250, "mass_g": 140}
